entries.summary: Ran one preregistered H66-2 experiment (concordance of 10-vs-50 m step, dip-sense and crest-toe sharpness on the pinned 2 m LiDAR stack). Emitted and validated a 37,654-dot raster (float32, EPSG:32611, 0 NaN, values in [0,1], unique among the 21 rasters present). Verdict negative: the mass-matched terrain-only control is within 1.9x pooled, 99.95% of the mass is upland while the live-best incumbent's edge is in the basin, and the off-catalogue proxy does not order the live board at comparable mass (rho=+0.46, p=0.29 over the 35k-70k band). Bytes kept in artifacts/h66-2/ for audit; not published on the site; no slot used. Two corrections recorded: IR-66-BASE-01 (the first strata run's random control was an index-ordered corner sample; the advertised x16 upland ratio is x1.20) and IR-66-GUARD-02 (the stop guard hard-coded a foreign lane name).

Audited the legacy H66 path. Full-catalogue distance affects candidate eligibility before holdout scoring; the holdout is not the required buffered whole-geologic-segment/LiDAR-only protocol; the writer path conflicts with the official NaN-outside contract. Legacy H66 scores are not qualified HOLDOUT-DTI.
The official data tab redirected to login. No credentials were used and no competition rasters or sample grid are in this checkout.
